best.reason: Revised to address feedback: monomer1 is a bisphenol-A-type diglycidyl ether containing explicit epoxide motifs (C1OC1 present and a second epoxide as C2OC2) to provide multiple reactive epoxy rings for crosslinking. Monomer2 is diethylenetriamine (NCCNCCN) containing two NC motifs (two terminal -NH2-containing sequences written as NC) and a secondary amine, giving three nucleophilic N sites for efficient epoxy opening. The pair is a compatible epoxy–amine thermoset system (epoxide + amine), with the rigid aromatic diglycidyl core and multifunctional amine chosen to increase Tg and modulus toward the targets (high crosslink density and aromatic rigidity to approach Tg ≈150°C and Er ≈75 MPa). Functional-group and reactivity issues from the prior design have been corrected.
